Game Overview

Falling Pig is a animal title where embark on a thrilling descent with Felix the pig as you navigate a cascade of challenges. Tilt and tap to dodge obstacles, manage speed, and creatively alter environments. Enjoy whimsical cartoons unveiling Felix's personality, all while unlocking innovative skins that keep this fast-paced journey fresh and engaging.
